=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:722-726 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_semantic_errors`, `statuses = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}` keeps only the last entry for each path, and nothing in validate_result, _check_fields or _semantic_errors rejects a path that appears twice; a result that lists `docs/plans/a.md` as PARTIAL and then as COMPLETE therefore passes the COMPLETE-archive guard.
  WHY: validate_result returns no error and check_diff accepts the content-preserving rename, so run_apply commits and pushes with GH_PAT an archive of a plan the same result calls PARTIAL, while decide_outcome and render_report still show the PARTIAL row; severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT (sonnet notes the PR still goes through normal review, so the impact is limited); the highest rating is used here.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Add exactly one fragment when the PR changes observable behaviour (including new env vars); every new repo variable an operator can set must appear in the "New repo variables" row of the fragment's numbers table.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md line 10 (the "New repo variables" row)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment lists only PLAN_AUTOPILOT_ENABLED and PLAN_AUTOPILOT_MAINTENANCE_PR_STALE_HOURS, `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL` was added to `README.md:104` and to the `plan_autopilot` job env at `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (`PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL: ${{ vars.PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL || '' }}`), agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md documents it, and the folded CHANGELOG.md will leave out a new repo variable operators can set
- requirement: "Save the cache marker for `plan_autopilot_key`, only when the audit finished, whatever its outcome. Not on error or Claude capacity exit 80; on exit 80, follow the existing capacity-wait behaviour so a later tick retries." (issue #10091, Approach step 8)
  expected_change_site: `scripts/plan_autopilot.py::run_gate` and the marker-writing steps in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `run_gate` sets `save_marker=True` for `project_open` (`scripts/plan_autopilot.py:419-433`), `maintenance_pr_open`, and `dispatch_pending`, which are paths where the audit never starts; the workflow saves the cache whenever the report returns that value (`.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2767-2780`); a project that opens between `find_tracking` and the gate uses up the day's `(default-branch SHA, UTC day)` key
- requirement: The audit follows `/audit-plans` steps 1–8. Step 7 (`.claude/commands/audit-plans.md:54`) says that when a same-name completed plan differs, the `docs/plans/` version replaces the stale archive copy with `git mv -f`.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/plan_autopilot.py::check_diff` and the Step 7 instructions in `prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `check_diff` accepts only a new completed target (`A`) and rejects a modification (`M`) (`scripts/plan_autopilot.py:980-984, 993`), `prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt:59` tells the auditor to refuse the replacement, and the last run's tests and agents.d entry keep encoding this divergence
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:_semantic_errors, line 722 `statuses = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}` and line 724 `own = statuses.get(item["from"], statuses.get(item["to"]))` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The dict comprehension keeps only the last classification entry for each path, and nothing rejects a path listed twice, so a result with PARTIAL and then COMPLETE for `docs/plans/a.md` gets `own == "COMPLETE"` and passes the archive guard. This is the contradictory-classification bypass the last run set out to close, reached through a duplicate entry.
  WHY: validate_result returns no error, check_diff accepts the rename, and run_apply pushes the archive with GH_PAT, while decide_outcome and render_report keep the PARTIAL row; the impact is limited by normal PR review. Fix: reject duplicate `classification` paths in _semantic_errors (about 3 lines) so the run ends as `result_invalid`.
- HARDENING: scripts/plan_autopilot.py, _semantic_errors just before line 722: `paths = [c["path"] for c in obj["classification"]]`, then `if len(paths) != len(set(paths)): errors.append("classification: duplicate plan path")`; estimated 3 lines.
- HARDENING: changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md line 10, "New repo variables" row: add "`PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL` (default empty, meaning `openai/gpt-6-sol`)"; estimated 1 line.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- Note: three earlier-decided items were not re-reported: the marker saved on deterministic gate skips (entry[13] decision), the different-content Step 7 collision (deferred in entry[12]), and the two unmet acceptance tests (`tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py`, `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py`), which also fail on the merge-base. The dry run with `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_ENABLED=true` is post-merge Rollout step 2, so it is not a gap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:722 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_semantic_errors` builds `statuses = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}`, which collapses duplicate classification entries (last write wins), and nothing rejects a duplicate path, so the archive guard at lines 723-726 returns no error.
  WHY: A result with `[{path: docs/plans/a.md, status: PARTIAL}, {path: docs/plans/a.md, status: COMPLETE}]` plus an archive to `docs/completed/a.md` gets past `check_diff`, and `run_apply` pushes it with GH_PAT, while the status issue still reports PARTIAL.
- HARDENING: scripts/plan_autopilot.py:722: append "classification: duplicate plan path" when `len(paths) != len(set(paths))`; about 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: "New repo variables | `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_ENABLED` (default `false`), `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_MAINTENANCE_PR_STALE_HOURS` (default `24`) |" (changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md); every new repo variable must appear in the folded CHANGELOG.md.
  Expected change site: `changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md` line 10 (the "New repo variables" row).
  Evidence of absence: `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL` was added to `README.md:104` and to the `plan_autopilot` job env at `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, but `changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md:10` still lists only the other two variables.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Save the cache marker for `plan_autopilot_key`, only when the audit finished, whatever its outcome. Not on error or Claude capacity exit 80; ..." (issue #10091, Approach step 8)
  Expected change site: `scripts/plan_autopilot.py::run_gate` and the marker-writing steps in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`.
  Evidence of absence: `run_gate` sets `save_marker=True` for `project_open` (`scripts/plan_autopilot.py:419-433`), `maintenance_pr_open` and `dispatch_pending`; the workflow saves the cache on that value (`.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2767-2780`), so a project that opens late uses up the day's key.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: `/audit-plans` Step 7 (`.claude/commands/audit-plans.md:54`): a differing same-name completed plan is replaced with `git mv -f`.
  Expected change site: `scripts/plan_autopilot.py::check_diff` and the Step 7 instructions in `prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt`.
  Evidence of absence: `check_diff` rejects the `M` case (`scripts/plan_autopilot.py:980-984, 993`), and `prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt:59` tells the auditor to refuse the replacement.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:722-725, `_semantic_errors` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The archive guard accepts duplicate `classification` entries for the same path; the `statuses` dict keeps the last entry, and the validator does not reject duplicate paths.
  WHY: A plan listed as `PARTIAL` and then as `COMPLETE` passes the archive check, so `check_diff` can accept and push the archive even though the result reports the plan as partial.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:_semantic_errors, line 722: `statuses = {c["path"]: c["status"] for c in obj["classification"]}` and line 724: `own = statuses.get(item["from"], statuses.get(item["to"]))` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The dict comprehension keeps only the last entry per path, and no validator rejects a plan path listed twice, so PARTIAL followed by COMPLETE for `docs/plans/a.md` passes the archive guard the last run just tightened.
  WHY: validate_result returns no errors, check_diff accepts the rename (old_sha == new_sha), and run_apply pushes the archive with GH_PAT while the status issue shows PARTIAL. tests/test_plan_autopilot.py:919-924 covers the different-path case but not the same-path case. Fix: collect paths and append `"classification: duplicate plan path <path>"` on duplicates (3 lines).
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: The issue's §20 constraint requires one changelog.d fragment documenting the PR's new repo variables.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md (the "New repo variables" row of the numbers table, around line 10)
  Evidence of absence: README.md:104, the `plan_autopilot` job env in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, and agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md carry `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL`, but the fragment lists only `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_ENABLED` and `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_MAINTENANCE_PR_STALE_HOURS`.
- HARDENING: scripts/plan_autopilot.py, _semantic_errors line 722: reject duplicate classification paths; 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING: changelog.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md line 10: add `PLAN_AUTOPILOT_CODEX_MODEL (default empty = openai/gpt-6-sol)` to the row; 1 line; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Note: the two pass-1 TASK_GAP entries (marker saved on gate skips; Step 7 differing-archive replacement) were not re-flagged, because the editor explicitly deferred both with documented reasons and the judge rated both NIT.
